text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Black slightly shiny cropped nylon bomber jacket with silver snaps and zip, black scoop-neck tee, gray black camouflage wide cargo trousers, black high-top canvas sneakers with sculptural chunky soles.. Add ONLY these accessories: Black ribbed short beanie with folded cuff and tiny white oval side emblem; Large soft black leather handbag with metal rivets, rings and hanging long straps; Long fine silver chain necklace with small rectangular pendant, complete chain. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 3 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Black ribbed short beanie with folded cuff and tiny white oval side emblem; 2. Large soft black leather handbag with metal rivets, rings and hanging long straps; 3. Long fine silver chain necklace with small rectangular pendant, complete chain. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
